newsitem.title: ITALY: Autogrill sees 1997 H1 in line with Q1.
newsitem.headline: Autogrill sees 1997 H1 in line with Q1.

text.p: Italian roadside restaurant chain Autogrill SpA expects first half 1997 results to be in line with the first quarter which saw slightly higher sales and an increase in margins, managing director Paolo Prota Giurleo said.

He also told a press briefing that the planned merger of Autogrill, its listed controlling holding Finanziaria Autogrill SpA, and Edizione Holding's Schemaventidue SpA will be operational from August 1. Majority shareholder Edizione is the Benetton family's holding company.
"We see a first half with figures similar to those in the first three months of the year," Prota Giurleo said.
In the first quarter, Autogrill posted a rise in the group's gross operating margin of over 20 percent while overall turnover rose 2.6 percent from the year-ago period.
Prota Giurleo had said in April that operating results for the full year 1997 would be in line with those seen in 1996.
Autogrill posted 1996 group operating profits of 87.5 billion lire, up 17 percent on 1995, on turnover up six percent to 1.71 trillion lire.
At 1105 GMT, Autogrill stock was up 1.12 percent to 2,975 lire on a strongly firmer Milan stock market.
